title: Quantum Foundations in Lean: Finite-Dimensional Formalizations and Typed Premise Audits
description: AFM-facing audit and reviewer release of the Lean 4 / Mathlib finite-dimensional quantum-foundations library. Relative to v1.4.0-journal-audit, this release changes no theorem body. It adds QuantumFoundations/Audit/AFM.lean, which #checks and #print axioms the exact principal Gleason/Busch and QuantumFoundations declarations used by the AFM manuscript; AFM_ARTIFACT.md, which maps manuscript results to frozen artifacts; scripts/verify_afm.sh, which builds and runs the audit in one command; and refreshed publication/reproducibility documentation. The mathematical surface includes Wigner and one-directional Uhlhorn--Semrl, projective and effect-perspective Born representation, elementary binary refinements and sharpness witnesses, finite Naimark dilation, and the strict residual-dimension classification of binary implementations. The direct Gleason dependency remains pinned to v1.1.0-journal-audit at commit 5c5bc40d2e4a31a0d1b3112fcc9a3e92b2000ec5.
